art_instructions: The image shows a cozy attic-style bedroom with sloped walls and a low ceiling made of exposed wooden beams. The room is softly lit with warm amber light from a small lantern on the nightstand. The walls are creamy white, and the wooden furniture is rich brown. In the center of the image, a small brown-and-cream owl with round amber eyes sits up in a wooden bed against the far wall. The owl has just woken up, with one wing slightly raised and eyes open wide, looking alert but calm. The bed is neatly made with forest green blankets and surrounded by plush cushions. A tiny nightstand beside the bed holds the glowing lantern and a stack of picture books. Shelves along one wall are filled with stuffed animals and trinkets. The owl's tiny satchel is placed on the nightstand, and a small green scarf is visible at the owl's neck. The overall mood is peaceful and warm, showing the beginning of a new day.
